data.title: 风见一姬 · 纯白床榻半透真丝睡裙侧卧与弱点失神真情释放
data.description: 【风见一姬 · 纯白床榻半透真丝睡裙侧卧与弱点失神真情释放】疗养所单人私密寝室内，月华洒满纯白柔软的大床被褥。一姬身上罩着一件极轻薄的半透明纯白真丝吊带睡裙（sheer camisole）。如云雾般微透的薄纱下，她白皙娇小的身躯曲线与粉嫩小巧的胸脯若隐若现。她侧卧蜷缩在丝绸枕席间，及地的雪白长发如银河般铺散开来，娇小柔韧的细腿微屈。单手抚摸着心口，另一只手在薄纱下摆深处轻柔律动，深红如宝石的双眸第一次滑落安心与极度依恋的清泪，额头深埋枕间微弱娇吟——「无论遇到怎样的绝境……只要在你身边……我都不会再感到害怕了……哈啊……」

data.promptProse: A deeply moving, ethereal anime illustration of Kazami Kazuki from The Fruit of Grisaia reclining on her side upon a pristine white convalescent bed at night. She wears a semi-translucent, gossamer-light white silk camisole slip that drapes delicately over her slender, porcelain torso, leaving her delicate contours enticingly visible under the moonbeams. Her floor-length silver-white hair spreads across the pillows like spun moonlight, while her slender legs are curled together in tender vulnerability. Cupping her small chest with one hand, her other hand rhythmically strokes her dripping intimate center beneath the gossamer hem as tears of pure, unburdened love shimmer in her ruby-red eyes. Soft lunar glow, silky cloth physics, delicate anime linework, solo 1girl, completely alone in peaceful solitude, fine anime art style.
data.nsfwProse: Curling on her side across pristine white sheets in a sheer translucent camisole with floor-length silver hair pooling around her, Kazuki tenderly pleasures her drenched core, weeping sweet quiet tears of emotional salvation in peaceful solitude.
